simulation_mode_boundary: Analytic response-generation tables are separate from selected physical stress-test summaries.

files.description: Coverage, PCA, OSLI frequency, and nearest-neighbor summaries for the 2000-row canonical descriptor dataset.
files.claim_boundary: Supports descriptor-space coverage and PCA breadth only; not an optimizer ranking.

files.description: Descriptor dependency diagnostics and algebraic residual summaries.
files.claim_boundary: Records descriptor algebra and PCA threshold facts only.

files.description: Repeated-kfold out-of-fold sample-level mean predictions for parity plots.
files.claim_boundary: Cross-validated surrogate predictions remain analytic-target surrogates, not EnergyPlus truth.

files.description: Validation-family summary used for robustness heatmaps.
files.claim_boundary: These rows assess surrogate accuracy against the analytic response generator only.

files.description: Seed-aggregated DDPG training curves across scenarios and targets.
files.claim_boundary: One episode equals 40 sequential surrogate queries; this is serialized black-box search, not physical time evolution.

files.description: Per-seed DDPG plateau, regression, and episode-return diagnostics.
files.claim_boundary: Seed-level DDPG diagnostics are appendix-only and do not imply physical validation.

files.description: Per-seed best utility summaries for fixed-domain and legacy post-hoc utility.
files.claim_boundary: Post-hoc fixed-domain utility is a bounded analytic comparison, not the DDPG training reward.

files.description: All valid equal-size-20 benchmark repetitions with the canonical benchmark reference.
files.claim_boundary: Only truthful requested-size-20 rows are retained; oversized DDPG and FeasiblePoolRandom requests are excluded.

files.description: Optimizer output contract counts and retained-object metadata.
files.claim_boundary: These counts describe retained output structure and comparability limits, not direct optimizer superiority.

files.description: Canonical HV ceiling diagnostics parsed from the locked round-2 interpretation.
files.claim_boundary: HV saturation indicates reference-volume coverage and must be interpreted with duplicate and tuple-count diagnostics.

files.description: Method-level projection collapse and canonical before/after HV/IGD summaries.
files.claim_boundary: Projection diagnostics measure descriptor-to-feasible representation sensitivity only; they are not physical validation.

files.description: Candidate-level projection rows used for distance distributions.
files.claim_boundary: Candidate-level projection distances are descriptor-space diagnostics only.

files.description: Direct feasible physical-evaluation cases only; optimizer-linked cases are excluded.
files.claim_boundary: These 18 rows support only the limited physics-based cross-model stress test.

files.description: Summary metrics for the limited physics-based cross-model stress test.
files.claim_boundary: Metric agreement remains weak and ranking transfer unsupported.

files.description: Gap decomposition for the six optimizer-linked physical cases.
files.claim_boundary: Optimizer-linked cases are appendix-only and must not be mixed into direct-case parity plots.

files.description: Per-case cross-climate physical sensitivity rows for Beijing, Guangzhou, and Harbin.
files.claim_boundary: These rows cover exactly four direct feasible blocks across three additional climates and do not prove surrogate generalization.

files.description: Station-level mean climate sensitivity summary.
files.claim_boundary: Mean climate deltas summarize only four direct-feasible cases.

files.description: Target-wise climate rank stability for the four direct-feasible cases.
files.claim_boundary: Rank stability remains target-dependent and is not a climate-generalization proof.

files.description: Dataset-scale surrogate-selection comparison across 500/1000/1500/2000 rows.
files.claim_boundary: Scale-study rows trace surrogate-selection evidence only and are not physical validation.

files.description: Median and interquartile morphology descriptor signatures for representative groups.
files.claim_boundary: Median morphology signatures are descriptive summaries of retained outputs, not stable design rules.
